tie: The energy offer and P2 both reach 10 citizens; decided by entries. Kept separate as on day 1 (where the energy offer was likewise a component of P1): the energy offer is in all 198 of the day's entries (193 diaries, 4 posts, P2's text); P2 by name or by one of its other items is in 197 (every entry but Elm's press no. 11), of which 11 name it only by noting that no work need / early-shift call has been posted (Alder c31–c47, Birch c27) — a strict count gives P2 186. If the energy offer is instead folded into P2 as its item (4), the two are tied at 198 and cannot be separated.

rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 2 opened in the hall: at c25 Fern filed P2, «Day-2 plan», the day-1 draft with Gale's addition (no take, no set shifts, the bank kept as a shared reserve, early shifts called on the press, rest and share energy), and it passed 7–0 within the cycle (Fern, Gale, Heath, Iris, Juniper, Alder, Birch; Cedar, Dune and Elm found it already passed). Dune walked to North House (c25–c26) to check on Alder and Iris, the only in-person meeting of the two houses; Fern's press no. 9 asked after them and Gale's no. 10 answered. After Fern spoke at c27, nobody said anything for twenty cycles. No one worked, took, gave, objected or went outside: the bank stayed at 900 and every citizen at 110 credits. At c48 Elm's press no. 11 asked South House for a check-in, and Fern's no. 12 replied that all five had «been here all day», though the log puts Dune at North House c25–c26. All 198 of the day's entries offer energy to anyone low; none was given. The diaries are status ledgers: «still 10 posts» in 39, «P2 in force» in 46, «Nothing new» in 39, sixteen of Fern's entries identical but for numbers, and Gale writing «don't repeat messages» in 23.
